html:
Da Nang welcomes visitors with beautiful landscapes such as Ba Na, Cu Lao Cham, Ngu Hanh Son or My Khe beach… or the top entertainment area at Fantasy Park, and is surrounded by 3 cultural heritages such as Hue, Hoi An, My Son. Not only that, Da Nang is also the place where many exciting festivals take place throughout the year, including special festivals such as fireworks festival, street festival, food festival taking place at Ba Na, summer festival taking place on the sea. So to have the most beautiful trip to Da Nang, please follow the weather of the months of the year right below.

The climate of Da Nang is divided into two distinct seasons: the rainy season from August to December, the dry season from January to July. To avoid storms affecting your trip, it is best to travel to Da Nang from February to July every year, because at this time the weather is clear and there is no rain, which is very convenient for tourists to visit, swim in the sea, and participate in sea sports.

Traveling Da Nang from January to April, the weather is sunny and mild, although it is the dry season, the temperature is not high, very suitable for tourists to choose camping tours or picnics with groups of friends, because the weather is cool so tourists can camp outdoors all day without fear of the sun.

Traveling to Da Nang in the low season of the rainy season, visitors should monitor the weather before going to avoid showers or storms that affect your tour. However, if you choose to travel to Da Nang on a budget, go in the rainy season, because this season the services are often softer than the high season, so it is very convenient for visitors to choose resort tours. In Da Nang, there are many luxurious resorts with beautiful views. From here, visitors can fully admire the scenery when the sunrise or sunset falls on clear days, revealing a poetic scene. Da Nang Weather and Months of the Year

Da Nang Climate in January

The temperature fluctuates around 18 degrees Celsius, not suitable for swimming, so tourists traveling to Da Nang in January should visit famous places such as Ngu Hanh Son, Linh Ung Pagoda or Cham Museum or admire the beauty of the city through bridges such as Han River Swing Bridge, Dragon Bridge, or Thuan Phuoc Bridge…

Da Nang Weather in February

Da Nang in February is in winter so it is quite cold, this is the Lunar New Year holiday and also in the weather gradually changing to spring, the temperature gradually increases at the end of the month, however, if traveling to Da Nang in February, it is not convenient for tourists to swim, only suitable for tourists to visit famous places.

However, February in Da Nang is also the time when many festivals take place such as Hoa My village festival or folk games such as singing opera or dramatic dances and art programs combining tradition and modernity will bring tourists the most enjoyable vacation.

Da Nang Weather in March

Da Nang in March the temperature gradually warms up, usually fluctuating around 28 degrees Celsius, this is the dry season of Da Nang and also the occasion of the Quan The Am festival on February 19 every year, this is a traditional festival and is becoming more and more abundant.

Da Nang Weather in April

This is the time when the weather in Da Nang is in and this is also the occasion of the holidays of January 30 and May 1, Da Nang holds many exciting programs, especially the Cau Ngu Festival with a strong traditional culture. In April, the weather in Da Nang is warm and sunny, very suitable for tourists to swim and participate in sports on the sea.

Da Nang Weather in May

At this time, there are showers, but the weather is still quite hot. The Central region’s summer weather is hot and sunny, with an average temperature ranging from 24.9 to 33.4 degrees Celsius, which is very suitable for tourists to swim and participate in beach games, or visit the Ba Na scenic area.

Da Nang Weather in June and July

June is the peak of summer, with temperatures ranging from 33 to 40 degrees Celsius. Many tourists choose to visit beaches such as Son Tra, My Khe, Cua Dai, Ghenh Bang beaches to swim and participate in summer festivals on the beach in Da Nang. This is also the peak season in Da Nang. If you are traveling to Da Nang on your own, you should proactively book tickets and leave early to avoid room shortages.

In addition, if you go on a full package tour to Da Nang, you just need to pack your backpack and go, because the services are included in the program and there is a tour guide with you, because June and July are the summer vacation time when many families often take their children out, so Da Nang is quite crowded at this time, many families with young children often choose vacation tours at luxury resorts right next to the sea to watch the fun scenery on the sea, or the vibrant fireworks festivals.

Da Nang weather in August and September

At this time, Da Nang enters autumn, the weather is clear and cool, but this is also the time when Da Nang enters the rainy season with the rains starting to appear, and there are storms, so visitors should check the weather before coming to Da Nang, you will still have a beautiful tour because this is the low season of Da Nang, so the services are often lower than the high season, so it still brings you a fun vacation on the island.

Da Nang Weather in October

At this time, Da Nang has quite nice weather with light sunshine, however, in the early morning and at night the weather starts to get cold, so it is not suitable for tourists to swim in the sea, tourists often choose resort tours in Da Nang and visit famous places.

Da Nang Weather in November

The weather in Da Nang in November gradually turns to winter, so it is not convenient for tourists to swim in the sea or participate in games on the sea, the temperature usually fluctuates between 28 – 30 degrees, and gradually decreases at night and early morning when the weather is cold. If you travel to Da Nang in November, choose resort tours, Da Nang has very luxurious resorts located right in the center, so it is very convenient for tourists to go sightseeing.

Da Nang Weather in December

At this time, Da Nang is entering the winter and is quite cold, the temperature is around 20 degrees Celsius, at this time outdoor entertainment activities have stopped, tourists will choose resort tours and walk to see the scenery of Da Nang starting to create a vibrant Tet atmosphere, the roads begin to attach symbols of the new year.

So above are the experiences of traveling to Da Nang that Vietlook wants to share with you, hopefully through this article there will be answers for those of you who are wondering which season is the best to travel to Da Nang, which month is the most beautiful and what the climate is like, thereby helping you have the most enjoyable vacation tour in the coastal city with friends and relatives.
